subject: Request to continue demo environment while procurement clears
messages:
From: Susan Kim <susan.kim@curahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@curahealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: extend demo access while procurement completes PO

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from our side — procurement has put a hold on issuing the PO while they finish a short vendor security addendum (we expect clearance but the committee meeting slipped by two weeks). We have an executive product review on December 2 and need the demo environment live for that session.

Can Redwood extend our sandbox/demo access for ~10 business days (to cover the review + legal routing) while we finalize the PO? We're comfortable with a usage cap and signing a one-page interim acknowledgement if needed. I've attached an intent-to-purchase that our CFO signed.

Attachments: PO_intent.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate any flexibility — will follow up with Tom (procurement) if you need procurement-specific contact or timelines.

Thanks,
Susan Kim
Head of Product
CuraHealth
S: (415) 555-0182

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Kim <susan.kim@curahealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: extend demo access while procurement completes PO

Thanks for the heads-up, Susan — and thanks for sending the intent doc. Camila / Ben, heads-up: CuraHealth's procurement committee delayed official PO routing; they have an exec review Dec 2 and want the demo live through that date.

Susan: we can probably accommodate an interim continuation. Two quick asks before I confirm formally with CS/Finance: 1) can you confirm the maximum daily token usage you expect during the review (ballpark is fine), and 2) confirm that Tom will route the PO within the 14-day window if we extend. If you can reply here I'll get this authorized.

I'm tentatively proposing a 14-calendar-day continuation with a modest soft cap and a one-page interim acknowledgement that preserves limited liability for both sides. Camila — can you draft the short terms and handle the temporary credit assignment? Ben — please chime in if we should gate by region or account team approval.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Consultant, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-2301

Hi Susan — good to hear and thanks for the context. We're able to extend your demo environment while procurement completes the PO. I've drafted a brief interim continuation agreement and applied a conservative usage cap so we don't drift into production-level spend while you finalize paperwork.

Key points (interim continuation):
- Extension length: 14 calendar days from today (ends 2027-12-05)
- Usage cap: 150K tokens total for the extension window (can be increased with notice)
- Conditions: PO submitted within extension window and a signed interim acknowledgement (attached).
- Support: standard demo support only (no guaranteed SLA); we can add a one-hour executive walkthrough the week of Dec 1 if useful.

Attachments: temp_access_terms.pdf (one-page interim acknowledgement)

Next action: Susan — if that works, sign the attached acknowledgement and reply here. Tom — if you can confirm PO routing target date, we'll keep the environment live until Dec 5. If procurement needs more time we can review a short one-off extension but will escalate through Ben/Finance.

Thanks — Camila
